title: Issuing-organization pack (공문 발신 기관 vocabulary)
description: The 기관명/부서/직위 vocabulary a 공문's 두문 (행정기관명), 발신명의, 결문 (처리과명) and 결재란 (직위) seats are filled from. It is a PACK, never hardcoded: which agency issues a document, which departments exist and which ranks sign are per-installation facts, and a real organization chart is personal data that must not live in this repository. The shipped default instance is therefore deliberately empty — check_gongmun skips the pack rules and says so (skipped: pack_vocabulary_empty) rather than inventing an organization.

organizations.description: 행정기관명 / 발신명의 values this installation may issue under (e.g. a ministry or school name).

departments.description: 처리과명 values: the departments that may appear in 시행/접수 numbering and in the 발신명의 line.

ranks.description: 직위(직급) values the 결재란 seats may name.
